xray_imaging.label: Skull X-Ray
xray_imaging.patient_label: An X-ray of your skull to check for bone injuries or abnormalities.

indications.label: Head trauma with palpable deformity
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Skull — palpable bony deformity following direct head trauma.

indications.label: Post-traumatic headache persisting weeks
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Skull — persistent headache following head injury, to exclude bony pathology.

indications.label: Suspected bony lump on skull
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Skull — palpable bony mass on calvarium, query osteoma or other bony lesion.

xray_imaging.label: TMJ X-Ray
xray_imaging.patient_label: An X-ray of your jaw joint to check why it may be clicking, locking, or painful.

indications.label: Jaw clicking with limited opening
indications.referral_text: X-Ray TMJ — painful clicking and restricted mouth opening, to assess joint surfaces.

indications.label: Jaw locking episodes
indications.referral_text: X-Ray TMJ — recurrent jaw locking, to exclude bony obstruction or joint derangement.

indications.label: Post-traumatic jaw pain and malocclusion
indications.referral_text: X-Ray TMJ — jaw pain with altered bite following facial trauma, to exclude condylar fracture.

indications.label: Chronic TMJ crepitus worsening progressively
indications.referral_text: X-Ray TMJ — progressive crepitus and pain on jaw movement, to assess for degenerative changes.

xray_imaging.label: Cervical Spine X-Ray
xray_imaging.patient_label: An X-ray of your neck to check the bones and joints of your upper spine.

indications.label: Neck pain after significant trauma
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Cervical Spine — neck pain following significant trauma, to exclude fracture or instability.

indications.label: Chronic neck stiffness over 50
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Cervical Spine — persistent neck stiffness and reduced range in patient over 50, to assess degenerative changes.

indications.label: Suspected cervical instability or hypermobility
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Cervical Spine with flexion-extension views — suspected segmental instability on clinical examination.

indications.label: Radiculopathy not responding to treatment
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Cervical Spine — persisting radicular arm symptoms unresponsive to six weeks of physiotherapy.

indications.label: Trauma with neurological signs in limbs
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Cervical Spine — post-traumatic neck pain with bilateral upper or lower limb neurological signs, suspected cord compromise.

xray_imaging.label: Thoracic Spine X-Ray
xray_imaging.patient_label: An X-ray of your mid-back to check the bones and alignment of your thoracic spine.

indications.label: Increased kyphosis in older patient
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Thoracic Spine — progressive kyphotic posture in elderly patient, to exclude compression fracture.

indications.label: Thoracic pain with trauma history
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Thoracic Spine — localised thoracic pain following a fall, to exclude fracture.

indications.label: Adolescent back pain with postural change
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Thoracic Spine — adolescent with worsening thoracic kyphosis and mid-back pain, to assess for Scheuermann's disease.

indications.label: Suspected scoliosis assessment
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Thoracic Spine full-length — clinical suspicion of scoliosis, to assess curve magnitude and pattern.

indications.label: Night pain with weight loss history
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Thoracic Spine — unrelenting thoracic pain worse at night with unintended weight loss, to screen for bony pathology.

xray_imaging.label: Lumbar Spine X-Ray
xray_imaging.patient_label: An X-ray of your lower back to check the bones, disc spaces, and alignment.

indications.label: Low back pain after fall
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Lumbar Spine — acute low back pain following a fall, to exclude fracture.

indications.label: Chronic low back pain over 50
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Lumbar Spine — chronic low back pain in patient over 50, to assess for degenerative or structural pathology.

indications.label: Suspected spondylolisthesis on examination
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Lumbar Spine with oblique views — clinical suspicion of spondylolisthesis, palpable step deformity.

indications.label: Young athlete with extension back pain
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Lumbar Spine — young athlete with pain on lumbar extension, to assess for pars stress fracture.

indications.label: Acute back pain with bilateral neurology
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Lumbar Spine — acute onset low back pain with bilateral lower limb neurological signs, to exclude significant bony pathology.

xray_imaging.label: Sacrum X-Ray
xray_imaging.patient_label: An X-ray of the triangular bone at the base of your spine.

indications.label: Direct fall onto buttocks
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Sacrum — central low back and buttock pain after a fall onto the buttocks, to exclude sacral fracture.

indications.label: Sacral pain in osteoporotic patient
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Sacrum — persistent sacral pain in patient with known osteoporosis, to screen for insufficiency fracture.

indications.label: Post-partum persistent sacral pain
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Sacrum — persistent sacral pain after childbirth not responding to conservative management.

xray_imaging.label: SI Joint X-Ray
xray_imaging.patient_label: An X-ray of the joints connecting your spine to your pelvis.

indications.label: Young adult with inflammatory back pain
indications.referral_text: X-Ray SI Joints — young adult with morning stiffness and buttock pain, to screen for sacroiliitis.

indications.label: Positive sacroiliac provocation tests
indications.referral_text: X-Ray SI Joints — multiple positive SI joint provocation tests with suspected inflammatory pathology.

indications.label: Alternating buttock pain with stiffness
indications.referral_text: X-Ray SI Joints — alternating buttock pain with morning stiffness exceeding 30 minutes, to assess for inflammatory sacroiliitis.

indications.label: SI joint pain after pelvic trauma
indications.referral_text: X-Ray SI Joints — post-traumatic SI joint region pain, to exclude fracture or diastasis.

xray_imaging.label: Rib X-Ray
xray_imaging.patient_label: An X-ray of your ribs to check for fractures or other bone problems.

indications.label: Rib pain after direct blow
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Ribs — localised rib pain and tenderness after direct impact, to assess for fracture.

indications.label: Rib pain with breathing difficulty
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Ribs and Chest — rib trauma with shortness of breath, to exclude fracture and pneumothorax.

indications.label: Stress fracture in rower or athlete
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Ribs — localised rib pain in athlete with repetitive loading, to screen for stress fracture.

indications.label: Multiple rib trauma in elderly patient
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Ribs — elderly patient with multiple rib tenderness after fall, to quantify rib fractures and exclude complications.

xray_imaging.label: Pelvis X-Ray
xray_imaging.patient_label: An X-ray of your pelvis to check the pelvic bones, hip joints, and surrounding area.

indications.label: Pelvic pain after high-energy trauma
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Pelvis — pelvic pain and inability to weight-bear following high-energy trauma, to exclude pelvic fracture.

indications.label: Groin pain in elderly after fall
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Pelvis — groin and anterior pelvic pain in elderly patient following a fall, to exclude pubic rami or hip fracture.

indications.label: Suspected leg length discrepancy
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Pelvis standing — clinical suspicion of structural leg length discrepancy affecting gait and spinal alignment.

indications.label: Bilateral hip stiffness in younger adult
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Pelvis — bilateral hip stiffness and groin pain in younger patient, to assess joint morphology.

xray_imaging.label: Shoulder X-Ray
xray_imaging.patient_label: An X-ray of your shoulder to check the bones and joint for injuries or wear.

indications.label: Shoulder pain after fall on arm
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Shoulder — acute shoulder pain and limited movement following a fall onto outstretched hand, to exclude fracture or dislocation.

indications.label: Recurrent shoulder dislocation history
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Shoulder — recurrent anterior shoulder instability, to assess for bony Bankart or Hill-Sachs lesion.

indications.label: Shoulder stiffness with painful arc
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Shoulder — chronic shoulder pain with painful arc and limited range, to assess for calcific tendinopathy or acromial morphology.

indications.label: Post-dislocation follow-up assessment
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Shoulder — follow-up after shoulder dislocation and reduction, to confirm joint congruency.

indications.label: ACJ pain after direct impact
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Shoulder including acromioclavicular joint — localised ACJ tenderness after a fall onto the point of the shoulder, to exclude ACJ injury.

xray_imaging.label: Humerus X-Ray
xray_imaging.patient_label: An X-ray of your upper arm bone to check for fractures or other problems.

indications.label: Upper arm pain after direct trauma
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Humerus — acute upper arm pain, swelling, and deformity after trauma, suspected humeral shaft fracture.

indications.label: Upper arm pain with wrist drop
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Humerus — upper arm pain with wrist drop suggesting radial nerve involvement, to localise fracture.
finds: Spiral fracture with radial nerve compromise

indications.label: Atraumatic arm pain with malignancy
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Humerus — atraumatic progressive upper arm pain in patient with history of malignancy, to screen for pathological lesion.

xray_imaging.label: Elbow X-Ray
xray_imaging.patient_label: An X-ray of your elbow to check for fractures, joint damage, or loose bodies.

indications.label: Elbow pain after fall on hand
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Elbow — elbow pain and swelling after fall onto outstretched hand, to exclude fracture.

indications.label: Elbow locking or catching sensation
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Elbow — recurrent elbow locking and catching, to assess for loose bodies or osteophyte formation.

indications.label: Chronic lateral elbow pain unresolving
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Elbow — chronic lateral elbow pain not responding to physiotherapy, to exclude bony cause.

indications.label: Elbow dislocation with neurovascular concern
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Elbow — suspected elbow dislocation with neurovascular compromise requiring emergency assessment.

xray_imaging.label: Forearm X-Ray
xray_imaging.patient_label: An X-ray of your forearm to check the two bones between your elbow and wrist.

indications.label: Forearm pain and deformity post-fall
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Forearm — forearm pain with visible deformity after fall, suspected radius and ulna fracture.

indications.label: Isolated ulna fracture after direct blow
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Forearm — localised ulna pain after direct blow to forearm, suspected nightstick fracture.

indications.label: Forearm pain with rotation restriction
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Forearm — persistent forearm pain with limited pronation and supination after injury, to assess bone alignment.

xray_imaging.label: Wrist X-Ray
xray_imaging.patient_label: An X-ray of your wrist to check the bones and joints for fracture or injury.

indications.label: Wrist pain after fall on hand
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Wrist — wrist pain and swelling after fall onto outstretched hand, to exclude distal radius fracture.

indications.label: Anatomical snuffbox tenderness post-fall
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Wrist with scaphoid views — tenderness in anatomical snuffbox after fall, to assess for scaphoid fracture.

indications.label: Chronic wrist pain with clicking
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Wrist — chronic wrist pain with clicking, to assess for carpal instability or arthropathy.

indications.label: Wrist stiffness with reduced grip strength
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Wrist — wrist stiffness and weakened grip strength, to assess for degenerative or post-traumatic changes.

xray_imaging.label: Hand X-Ray
xray_imaging.patient_label: An X-ray of your hand to check the small bones and joints for injury or disease.

indications.label: Finger pain after ball impact
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Hand — finger pain and swelling after ball impact or jamming injury, to exclude phalangeal fracture or dislocation.

indications.label: Punching injury with metacarpal pain
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Hand — pain and swelling over metacarpal heads after punching impact, suspected boxer's fracture.

indications.label: Multiple joint swelling and stiffness
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Hands bilateral — multiple joint swelling and stiffness in small joints, to assess for inflammatory or degenerative arthropathy.

indications.label: Thumb pain after forced abduction
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Thumb — thumb pain at MCP joint after forced abduction, to exclude fracture associated with ligament injury.

xray_imaging.label: Hip X-Ray
xray_imaging.patient_label: An X-ray of your hip joint to check the ball-and-socket joint for damage or wear.

indications.label: Hip pain after fall in elderly
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Hip — acute hip pain and inability to weight-bear in elderly patient after fall, to exclude neck of femur fracture.

indications.label: Progressive groin pain with stiffness
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Hip — progressive groin pain and restricted hip range, to assess for osteoarthritis.

indications.label: Groin pain in active young adult
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Hip — groin pain limiting sport in young active adult, to assess for femoroacetabular impingement morphology.

indications.label: Hip pain with AVN risk
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Hip — persistent hip pain in patient with history of corticosteroid use or alcohol excess, to screen for avascular necrosis.

indications.label: Shortened externally rotated leg post-trauma
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Hip — shortened and externally rotated limb after fall, clinical suspicion of hip fracture with vascular risk.

xray_imaging.label: Femur X-Ray
xray_imaging.patient_label: An X-ray of your thigh bone to check for fractures or bone problems.

indications.label: Thigh pain after high-energy trauma
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Femur — thigh pain with deformity following high-energy impact, suspected femoral shaft fracture.

indications.label: Thigh pain on bisphosphonate therapy
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Femur — lateral thigh pain in patient on long-term bisphosphonate therapy, to assess for atypical femoral fracture.

indications.label: Atraumatic thigh pain with night symptoms
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Femur — atraumatic deep thigh pain worse at night, to screen for bony pathology.

xray_imaging.label: Knee X-Ray
xray_imaging.patient_label: An X-ray of your knee to check the bones and joint space for injury or arthritis.

indications.label: Knee pain after twisting injury
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Knee — acute knee pain and swelling after twisting mechanism, to exclude fracture per Ottawa Knee Rules.

indications.label: Chronic knee pain and stiffness
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Knee weight-bearing — chronic knee pain and stiffness, to assess for degenerative changes.

indications.label: Anterior knee pain with giving way
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Knee including skyline view — anterior knee pain and giving way, to assess patellofemoral joint.

indications.label: Knee unable to bear weight post-trauma
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Knee — unable to take four weight-bearing steps following trauma, Ottawa Knee Rules positive.

indications.label: Adolescent knee pain near growth plate
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Knee — adolescent with localised tibial tubercle pain, to assess for Osgood-Schlatter's or growth plate pathology.

xray_imaging.label: Tibia/Fibula X-Ray
xray_imaging.patient_label: An X-ray of your shin and lower leg bones to check for fractures or stress injuries.

indications.label: Lower leg pain after direct impact
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Tibia and Fibula — acute lower leg pain with deformity after direct trauma, suspected fracture.

indications.label: Shin pain in distance runner
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Tibia — localised shin pain in runner worsening with activity, to screen for tibial stress fracture.

indications.label: Lower leg fracture with vascular concern
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Tibia and Fibula — suspected displaced tibial fracture with neurovascular compromise, requiring emergency assessment.

indications.label: Persistent shin pain not resolving
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Tibia — persistent medial tibial pain unresponsive to load management over eight weeks.

xray_imaging.label: Ankle X-Ray
xray_imaging.patient_label: An X-ray of your ankle to check the bones and joint after an injury or for ongoing pain.

indications.label: Ankle inversion injury Ottawa rules positive
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Ankle — ankle sprain meeting Ottawa Ankle Rules criteria, to exclude malleolar fracture.

indications.label: Ankle pain with significant swelling
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Ankle — substantial ankle swelling and inability to weight-bear following injury, to exclude fracture or dislocation.

indications.label: Chronic ankle pain post-recurrent sprains
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Ankle — chronic ankle pain and instability following multiple sprains, to assess for osteochondral lesion or arthritis.

indications.label: Ankle weight-bearing for alignment assessment
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Ankle weight-bearing — chronic ankle symptoms with suspected malalignment or early arthritis.

xray_imaging.label: Foot X-Ray
xray_imaging.patient_label: An X-ray of your foot to check the bones and joints for fractures, arthritis, or deformity.

indications.label: Foot pain after twisting or fall
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Foot — midfoot or forefoot pain after twisting injury, Ottawa rules positive, to exclude fracture.

indications.label: Forefoot pain in runner increasing
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Foot — progressive forefoot pain in runner, to screen for metatarsal stress fracture.

indications.label: Big toe joint pain and stiffness
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Foot — pain and stiffness at the first metatarsophalangeal joint, to assess for hallux rigidus or bunion.

indications.label: Flat foot with progressive arch pain
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Foot weight-bearing — progressive arch collapse and medial foot pain, to assess bony alignment and degenerative changes.

indications.label: Heel pain unresponsive to treatment
indications.referral_text: X-Ray Foot lateral — persistent heel pain unresponsive to conservative management, to assess calcaneal pathology.
